quests.title: Connor's Brew

dialogue.sit: So, I hear you need dandelions...

dialogue.t: Oh, you must have seen my commission, then. Well, what about it? Have you gathered three sets of Dandelion Seeds?
Yes... These Dandelion Seeds should last me for a while.
Please accept this. Thanks for helping me out.

quests.description: The Dawn Winery’s Connor requires three sets of Dandelion Seeds.
